model_annotation: The image displays two line plots, labeled A and B, both illustrating trends over time from 2008 to 2021. In plot A, the x-axis represents “Години” (Years) with tick marks at 2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, and 2021, while the y-axis is labeled “Средни леглодни (дни)” (Average bed days, days), ranging from 200 to 280 days. A red line with black circular markers shows a general decline: starting at approximately 278 days in 2008, dipping to about 265 in 2012, rising slightly to 270 in 2013, then falling sharply to 240 in 2017 and reaching 198 by 2021. In plot B, the x-axis again shows “Години” (Years) with the same tick marks, and the y-axis is labeled “Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)” (Structural effect on average bed days, %), ranging from 0.5 to 2.5%. The red line with black circular markers begins at 1.55% in 2008, declines to 0.75% in 2012, drops further to 0.6% in 2013, rises to 1.3% in 2017, and climbs steeply to 2.8% by 2021. Both plots use a linear scale on both axes and share the same time intervals on the x-axis.
